summary: Iteration 2 comprehensive testing of new AI Website Builder features: /api/validate, /api/publish, /api/site/{id} endpoints and new UI (publish/clear/refresh/media buttons, code-in-tabs, localStorage persistence). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all 17 data-testids visible & functional, example command buttons fill input, add-image/add-video append prompts, missing API key shows Turkish/English alert, invalid API key surfaces error message in chat (no silent fail), publish flow returns real /api/site/{id} URL and site is retrievable via GET, refresh-preview works, clear-btn wipes localStorage code+messages, HTML tab shows blue dot indicator when code exists.
passed: GET /api/ → 200
POST /api/validate clean code → valid=true
POST /api/validate mismatched CSS/JS braces → returns errors, valid=false
POST /api/validate empty body → 200, valid=true, checked flags false
POST /api/validate unclosed div → warning returned
POST /api/publish + GET /api/site/{id} → site persisted in MongoDB, HTML/CSS/JS/title round-trip verified
GET /api/site/nonexistent → 404
POST /api/publish empty body → 200 success
POST /api/chat with invalid key → 200 SSE stream with error event (no 500 crash)
POST /api/chat with missing fields → 422 validation error

All 17 data-testids visible: publish-btn, clear-btn, refresh-preview-btn, add-image-btn, add-video-btn, settings-btn, provider-selector, model-selector, chat-input, send-btn, preview/html/css/js-tab, device-desktop/tablet/mobile, export-zip-btn
Example command buttons fill chat-input (Yılan oyunu tested)
add-image-btn appends picsum.photos image prompt
add-video-btn appends video prompt (newline separated)
Empty API key → alert (Turkish + English)
API keys persist to localStorage under ai_builder_keys
HTML tab shows blue dot '•' indicator when generatedCode.html exists
Publish button returns URL banner with backend /api/site/{id} link
Refresh preview button re-renders iframe
Clear button wipes localStorage messages and code (with confirm dialog)
Preview iframe renders when code exists
critical_code_review_comments: Builder.jsx is 890 lines — consider splitting into ChatPanel, PreviewPanel, HeaderBar sub-components for maintainability

sendMessage() closure captures stale generatedCode when merging incremental HTML/CSS/JS — currently mitigated because full code blocks arrive together, but could cause tab flicker on partial streams. Consider using functional setState with prev.
publishSite has no per-site cleanup/expiration policy; published_sites collection will grow unbounded
insertMediaPrompt uses setInput(prev => ...) with functional form OK, but the initial 'test' scenarios show newline concatenation may produce awkward prompts if user clears input mid-way
extractCode regex only matches ```html / ```css / ```javascript|js — AI may emit ```HTML or ```JS (case) which would be missed; consider /i flag
seed_data_creation: TEST_PublishTitle and TEST_Empty published sites created in MongoDB db.published_sites (not cleaned up — no delete endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/validate, /api/publish, /api/site/{id} fully verified with pytest (backend_test.py, 11 tests). Frontend Builder.jsx: all new features work — publish flow end-to-end verified (button → backend → banner URL → GET returns HTML). Full AI generation still requires real user-supplied API key; invalid key path is exercised & error surfaces in chat. Note: automation logs suggest main agent was concurrently editing server.py (introducing UploadFile imports without importing them — F821 undefined name warning) and Builder.jsx (added 'Resim yükle'/'Video yükle' file upload UI visible in screenshot). If file-upload feature is added, will need retest.
